messages.subject: plotmatrix question
parts:
Hello all,

I have two questions regarding the plotmatrix() function.

First, I have many variables and want to use plotmatrix to see their correlations. The scales of these variables are quite different, some are from 0 to 1, and some are from 0 to 1000. It seems that y axis of all matrix has a uniform scale and is really large to capture the one with biggest y value. The ones with small range are squeezed and cannot be clearly seen. I wonder is there option to fix this.
 
My second question is that is there a way to show the correlation coefficient on such a plot. Thanks for your input in advance!

Xiaoyu

messages.subject: RE: plotmatrix question
parts:
Hi Xiaoyu,

Have you looked at ggpairs from the GGally package, which is a plot matrix extension for ggplot2?

I read somewhere before that somebody recommended use ggpairs instead of plotmatrix, because ggpairs provides a vastly improved pairs plot.

 

http://rgm2.lab.nig.ac.jp/RGM2/func.php?rd_id=GGally%3aggpairs

 

On the other hand, I am still interested to learn how you managed the scales with plotmatrix using scale package…I appreciate if you could post some example.

Thank you,

Kaori
